# Gulf Business

> Gulf Business delivers comprehensive GCC business news, market analysis, and economic insights for the Middle East region.

Gulf Business is a leading digital media platform covering business, technology, energy, and lifestyle news across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries, particularly the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and broader Middle East. The site offers news, videos, podcasts, and a digital magazine featuring executive interviews and market analysis.

## Key Topics

- GCC business news
- UAE and Dubai markets
- Saudi Arabia and ADNOC
- Energy sector and oil prices
- Executive interviews
- Regional economic development
- Technology and innovation
- Middle East geopolitics
- Tourism and hospitality
- Business analysis and insights

## News & Breaking Updates

- [Homepage](https://gulfbusiness.com/en): Homepage delivering GCC business news, market analysis, and economic insights
- [Latest News](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/latest-news): Latest news from Middle East covering UAE, Dubai, and aviation
- [News Hub](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/news): News aggregation hub for Middle East, UAE, and regional updates
- [Newsfeed](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/newsfeed): Breaking business news and market trends across the Gulf region

## Industry Coverage

- [Industry](https://gulfbusiness.com/en/industry): Industry coverage of energy markets, Saudi Aramco, and commodities
